title: v1.4.1 — Mobile Layout, Sync Reliability & Security Rules Update
changelog: Mobile Routine Template Bar: Dedicated responsive selector and one-tap Planner shortcut on mobile screens
Firestore Security Rules: Enabled cloud read/write permissions for day templates, weekly planner, and goal progress
Native Android Update Detection: Fixed remote manifest resolution so installed APKs reliably receive update alerts
Real-Time Cloud Listeners: Instant background synchronization for routine templates and weekly schedule planner
Offline Seeding Fallback: Automatic initialization of default templates and daily goals when local cache is empty
Enhanced Touch Targets: Optimized quick-add buttons and responsive tabs for mobile viewports
